title: David Arquette’s unlikely championship
summary: Actor David Arquette becomes involved in DDP’s fight with Jarrett and Bischoff. An unusual title stipulation puts the belt on the celebrity before a triple-cage betrayal returns it to Jarrett.

chapters.title: Arquette becomes world champion
chapters.result: Arquette pins Bischoff in a tag match to win DDP’s championship.
chapters.context: The stipulation awards the belt to whoever scores the pin. This broadcast followed the April 25 recording.

chapters.title: Arquette turns on Page
chapters.result: Jarrett wins the triple-cage championship match against Arquette and DDP.
chapters.context: Arquette sides with Jarrett, betraying the wrestler who had brought him into the title picture.
